description: This file defines the TDistribution class, implementing Student's t-distribution for the Apache Commons Math library. It includes methods to calculate density, cumulative probability, and statistical properties like mean and variance, specific to the distribution.

classes.name: TDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of Student's t-distribution, providing methods for probability density, cumulative distribution, and statistical moments, inheriting from AbstractRealDistribution.

methods.name: getDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the degrees of freedom parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Computes the probability density function value at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the probability density function at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative distribution function value at a specified point.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution if defined; otherwise NaN.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution if defined; otherwise infinity or NaN.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support (always negative infinity).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support (always positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the lower support bound is inclusive (always false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the upper support bound is inclusive (always false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates if the support is connected (always true).
